$comment: §6.2 — the manifest a module's play_manifest export emits exactly once at the upload probe. Field names are the design's own. Names are scoped per seat; a reserved name (default, reflex_*) or a wrong abi rejects the module. `params` is the COMPLETE Appendix P.1 ParamSpec language, normatively encoded here (review finding: an unconstrained object let lanes diverge): at most 16 parameters, nesting depth ≤ 4, list caps ≤ 32, string caps ≤ 64 bytes.
title: play_manifest

doc.$comment: cap is UTF-8 BYTES, engine-enforced (JSON Schema maxLength counts code points and is deliberately not used); omit when empty

retune.$comment: must equal whether play_retune is exported (probe-verified)

params.$comment: parameter name -> ParamSpec; {} for a parameterless play; ≤ 16 parameters (MaxParamsPerSchema)

param_spec.$comment: One P.1 kind. Depth of nested specs (tuple items, union arms, set/list element specs) ≤ ParamNestingMax (4). `required: true` marks a parameter with no default; `default` must itself validate against the spec.

integer.$comment: number only; every count, tick, hit point, seat, zone phase, and brad is integral (P.1)

of.$comment: enum: the closed string set. set/list: the element kind — a kind NAME for scalar elements or a nested spec object.

items.$comment: tuple only: fixed arity, per-position kinds

arms.$comment: union only: exactly one key of these arms appears in a value

default.$comment: the literal default, absent for a required parameter; must validate against this spec
